notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a complete four-page primary results report headed “Replication of a Research Claim from Janssen et al. (2011), from Experimental Economics: Report”, by Johannes Jarke-Neuert, September 22, 2021. SOURCE_URL https://osf.io/a6nsp/download matches the assigned replication URL. The report cites the assigned Janssen/Anderies/Joshi (2011) title, journal and pages. Its author/date differ from the Field et al. November 2025 catalog-style ref_r; identity rests on the underlying project report, source URL and original-work identity, not the cache name. No report DOI or supplied PDF. Target selection rests on p. 2 explicitly identifying the lagged-share × position interaction as the research claim to be checked and describing Table 3 as the key replication model. No row-order or numeric matching. Table 4 gives alternative factorial specifications. Retain printed coefficient 4.524 and SE 0.477; no standardization or conversion to ser_method. The critical model prints N=630 observations and 14 groups. Table 1 separately reports 70 subjects and 700 nonpractice observations; these are not substituted for analytic N. No N summation or df inference. Table 3 says undefined lagged share was set to 0.2 in 20 observations, retaining them; full accounting of other model omissions is not explicitly given. Original side is an unassigned placeholder.
